subject: Post-demo spend corridor alignment & procurement gating
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
To: Claire Zhang <claire@brightmetrics.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 15:02:00 +0000
Subject: Post-demo spend corridor alignment & procurement gating

Claire — great speaking today. Quick recap and asks below so we can lock the pilot terms and get procurement moving.

Key notes from the call:
- Target workload: embeddings + chat reranker for analytics feature. Expected traffic profile: spikes during ETL refreshes but otherwise steady throughput.
- Volume estimate (customer-provided): 8M tokens/mo during pilot ramp -> 18–25M tokens/mo at steady state (3–4 month horizon).
- Reliability needs: <200 ms p95 inference for single-turn embeddings, can tolerate up to 500 ms for batch re-ranks.

Immediate asks / next steps:
1) Confirm monthly spend band we should price against (range options below). Please pick one so we can prepare a PO-ready quote:
   - Option A: Pilot band — $12k–$25k / month (8M–12M tokens)
   - Option B: Growth band — $25k–$60k / month (12M–30M tokens)
   - Option C: Enterprise band — $60k+ / month (30M+ tokens)

2) Procurement gating: what internal PO thresholds and lead times should we expect? In our experience: purchases >$25k/month typically require PO + 30–45 day legal cadence; purchases >$60k/month often need SOW and security questionnaire sign-off. Can you confirm BrightMetrics thresholds so we can align the quote?

3) Unit economics check: our standard target blended rate for embeddings + chat in these profiles is $1,750 / 1M tokens for pilot workload (volume-discounted for Band B/C). We can structure a graduated $/1M token schedule in the quote if preferred. Please indicate target $/1M token you want us to hold for budgeting.

Attachments: redwood-pricing-sheet.pdf (pricing bands + sample invoice), mutual-action-plan.xlsx (recommended milestones).

If you can reply with the selected spend band and internal procurement threshold by EOD Tuesday we’ll produce a PO-ready quote and a short SOW stub for legal.

Thanks — look forward to closing this out.

— Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
sofia@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0182

From: Claire Zhang <claire@brightmetrics.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@brightmetrics.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 19:11:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Post-demo spend corridor alignment & procurement gating

Thanks Sofia — good recap. A couple quick clarifications from our side: 

- The 8M–25M tokens estimate aligns with our internal modeling (happy to share the spreadsheet). We’re leaning toward Option B for budgeting, but need to confirm with procurement.
- Procurement thresholds: any recurring spend above $30k/month requires an approved PO and our standard security addendum; anything above $70k/month triggers an extra finance review and a 45–60 day legal SLA.

Question on unit economics: is the $1,750 / 1M tokens a blended pilot rate or AMI (apply to embeddings + chat) rate? If it’s blended, can you break out a sample split (embeddings vs chat) so our finance team can model margin per feature?

I’ve looped in procurement — Patty from procurement will respond with their PO process.

Best,
Claire
Claire Zhang
Head of Product, BrightMetrics
claire@brightmetrics.com

Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 01:38:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Post-demo spend corridor alignment & procurement gating

Claire — thanks for the quick reply and for looping procurement in. Short answers below to help Claire’s finance team model this: 

- $1,750 / 1M tokens is a blended pilot rate (embeddings + chat). For transparency here’s an example split for the workload you described (per 1M tokens):
   • Embeddings (dense vectors): $900 / 1M tokens
   • Chat/generation + reranking: $850 / 1M tokens
   (sum = $1,750 blended).

- For Band B (Growth band), we typically propose a stepped discount schedule tied to committed monthly thresholds: e.g., 0–12M @ $1,900; 12M–30M @ $1,650; 30M+ @ $1,400 (we can adjust).

- Procurement gating: we’ll prepare two quote templates — one for PO-only (monthly invoices) and one for PO + SOW (for >$60k). Both will include the standard security addendum.

Attaching the redwood-pricing-sheet.pdf with the breakdown and a draft mutual-action-plan.xlsx with proposed milestones and acceptance criteria.

Next steps I’ll own: produce a PO-ready quote for Option B with the stepped schedule and a 90-day pilot SOW stub by EOD tomorrow. Jonas — can you confirm the stepped discount tiers in the attached pricing sheet? Ben — can you draft the pilot SOW stub (one page) and drop in the shared Drive link when ready?

— Sofia

Hi Sofia / Claire — Patty here from Procurement. Quick note on our routing: 

- PO threshold: any recurring contract > $30,000/month requires a PO + vendor onboarding. Typical lead time 10–20 business days once we have a final quote and the signed security addendum.
- For commitments > $70,000/month we require a signed SOW and finance approval; expect 30–60 business days for full execution.
- Billing: net-30 is preferred; net-45 possible with finance approval.

Please send the PO-ready quote and the security addendum to procurement@brightmetrics.com. When you send the quote, include a simple invoice template so finance can route quickly.

Thanks — Patty
Patricia (Patty) Lo
Procurement Manager, BrightMetrics
procurement@brightmetrics.com

Internal note + next steps for Redwood team (keeping external copy for transparency):

Summary: BrightMetrics is verbally committing to Option B (Growth band). Procurement confirmed PO threshold kicks in at $30k/month and heavier review > $70k/month. Claire wants a stepped schedule broken out by embeddings vs chat so finance can model.

Action items:
- Jonas: finalize the stepped discount tiers in redwood-pricing-sheet.pdf and create a one-page summary table we can paste into the quote (due EOD today).
- Ben: draft the 90-day pilot SOW stub (focus on milestones, acceptance criteria, and rollback) and upload to the shared Drive link. Add a sentence about RTO/RPO for audit logs.
- Sofia: produce two quote templates (PO-only and PO+SOW) with net-30 and net-45 variants and attach invoice template. Send to procurement@brightmetrics.com once Jonas/Ben confirm artifacts.

Potential risks / flags:
- If final monthly commitment approaches $60k+, legal SLA may slip into 30–60 days; factor that into our delivery timeline.
- BrightMetrics asked for an embeddings vs chat split for unit economics — make sure the pricing sheet shows per-workload line items (not just blended).

I’ll own the outreach to Patty once artifacts are ready.

— Sofia
